feature.name: JobPilot: Onboarding & Verified Vault Setup
feature.summary: A new user starts the Telegram bot, uploads their PDF resume, verifies extracted achievement bullets, sets preferences and encryption, and arms the 09:00 AM daily job loop.

funnel.name: Reviews extracted bullets & approves verified facts
Sets AES-256 passphrase & target role/comp preferences
Vault locked & 09:00 AM daily loop scheduled

segments.name: Developer installing from GitHub / Kiro on desktop
Job seeker starting from Telegram on mobile
Privacy-cautious senior engineer testing it out

hypotheses.text: Activation: at least 75% of users who start onboarding finish verifying their vault.
Onboarding completes in 3 minutes (180s) or less.
Mobile Telegram seekers activate at least 50% of the time.

edge_cases.title: Typed data lost on error or navigation
edge_cases.question: If the step fails or the user steps back, is what they typed kept?
edge_cases.expected: Keep uploaded file and preference inputs if Docling fails or the user steps back.

edge_cases.title: Connection drops while waiting
edge_cases.question: Does the wait resume, restart or fail silently?
edge_cases.expected: Queue parsing locally and notify the user in Telegram once the 28 bullets are ready.

edge_cases.title: The thing being waited for never arrives
edge_cases.question: Is there a time limit and a next step when it runs out?
edge_cases.expected: Set a 30s Docling timeout; on expiry, offer plain-text fallback or manual bullet paste.

edge_cases.step_name: Sets AES-256 passphrase & target role/comp preferences

qualitative.note: Think-aloud walkthroughs drawn from events.sample.jsonl against proposals/01_JOBPILOT_PRODUCT_PROPOSAL.md Section 4.1.

sessions.persona: Ananya, Senior Backend Engineer installing from GitHub at her desk (User 0)
sessions.goal: Import her resume PDF and get daily 09:00 AM matches turned on

moments.thought: Dragging my LaTeX PDF into Telegram Desktop worked cleanly.
28 bullets in one Telegram message is a lot to eyeball on screen, though the metrics looked right.

sessions.quote: Worked well on desktop once I squinted through all 28 bullets.
sessions.unmet_need: Group bullets under each past role when reviewing.

sessions.persona: Rishabh, mid-level engineer discovering JobPilot on his phone (User 13)
sessions.context: mobile, flaky network, clean_single_col, lacks resume_file_ready
sessions.goal: Try out JobPilot right after seeing a hackathon demo link

moments.thought: It asks me to drop my PDF/DOCX resume in chat, but my latest resume is on Google Drive / my work laptop, not on my phone.

sessions.quote: I tapped /start on my phone and hit a wall immediately because it only takes a PDF file.
sessions.unmet_need: Let me paste my LinkedIn URL or a few paragraphs of text now and upload the PDF later.

sessions.persona: Karan, frontend lead with a 2-column Canva resume (User 4)
sessions.goal: Set up his vault before bed

moments.thought: It took 19 seconds and trimmed my Canva bullets to 110–118 chars, merging two side-bar skills into a role line.
The only button is 'Approve All Verified Facts'. Three of the 28 bullets got garbled by the 2-column parse and there is no way to fix just those three.

sessions.quote: I can't tap 'Approve All' when three bullets have mangled dates, and there's no edit button.
sessions.unmet_need: Per-bullet edit or reject before approving the vault.

sessions.persona: Priya, mobile seeker who happened to have her PDF in WhatsApp Files (User 7)

moments.thought: Reading 28 dense technical lines inside a narrow Telegram chat bubble on a 6-inch screen gave me a headache.

sessions.quote: Reviewing 28 resume lines in one chat message is impossible on a phone.
sessions.unmet_need: Review 3–5 bullets at a time, or send a clean mini-app checklist.

sessions.persona: Samir, Staff Engineer cautious about personal data (User 9)
sessions.goal: Test whether JobPilot really keeps data local

moments.thought: Even if SQLite is local, I'm uploading my unencrypted PDF through Telegram's cloud servers right here in step 1.

sessions.quote: Why am I sending my full contact info and resume over Telegram just to seed a local SQLite database?
sessions.unmet_need: Allow local CLI ingestion (`jobpilot ingest resume.pdf`) without ever sending the raw PDF through Telegram.

sessions.persona: Devika, desktop installer hitting an upload error (User 40)

moments.thought: The upload failed or timed out without saying whether it was file size, format, or Telegram bot state.

sessions.quote: It just errored out on upload with no guidance on format or size limits.
sessions.unmet_need: Show supported formats, max size, and a specific parse error message.

sessions.persona: Nikhil, desktop developer quitting at passphrase & prefs (User 18)
sessions.goal: Complete vault encryption and target role setup

moments.thought: Parser retried once and got through.
Now it asks me to type an AES-256 passphrase into Telegram chat, plus target titles, locations, and min comp, and doesn't say what happens if I forget the passphrase.

sessions.quote: Typing an encryption passphrase into a Telegram chat message feels wrong—and what if I forget it?
sessions.unmet_need: Use OS Keychain / local CLI for encryption keys instead of typing passphrases into chat.

themes.title: Requiring a local PDF file in Telegram blocks mobile users on step 1
themes.evidence: Rishabh lacked his resume PDF on his phone at upload_resume (37% of starters blocked there).
themes.recommendation: Add a fallback to paste LinkedIn URL or raw resume text on mobile, or import via local CLI.

themes.title: 'Approve All 28 Bullets' breaks on messy PDFs and tiny phone screens
themes.evidence: Karan (2-column Canva parse error) and Priya (wall of 28 lines on mobile) both quit at verify_bullets.
themes.recommendation: Group extracted bullets by role and allow tapping individual bullets to edit or exclude before locking.

themes.title: Privacy narrative clashes with sending raw PDFs and passphrases through Telegram
themes.evidence: Samir distrusted uploading his resume to Telegram, and Nikhil balked at typing his AES-256 passphrase into chat.
themes.recommendation: Support local CLI ingestion and OS Keychain key generation so sensitive files and passphrases never traverse Telegram.

spec_gaps.title: No partial/per-bullet edit path before 'Approve All Verified Facts'
spec_gaps.detail: Flow 1 shows a single '[Approve All Verified Facts]' button; if 2 of 28 bullets are mis-parsed, the spec gives no fix path.

spec_gaps.title: AES-256-GCM passphrase reset / loss behavior undefined
spec_gaps.detail: Proposal Section 7.3 derives keys from a local passphrase, but does not state how keys are entered or recovered if forgotten.

spec_gaps.title: Desktop ShadowMux pairing is absent from onboarding
spec_gaps.detail: Onboarding arms the 09:00 AM Telegram loop without checking whether desktop ShadowMux / Chrome cookie parity is set up.
